description: Reusable EcomIQ B-roll: real screen recordings of the Black Friday Profit Plan workbook and its companion tools, framed for compositing. Silent, un-branded building blocks — no logo, captions or end card.

common.audio: none — these clips are silent by design
common.captureSize: 1600x1000 (landscape UI, never cropped to go vertical)
common.framing: EcomIQ navy ground with a soft bloom and vignette; the recording sits in a rounded, soft-shadowed card, centred and sized as large as each ratio allows. The card makes a slow 0.985->1.015 push so the frame is never static, and there are no fades, so an editor can cut in or out on any frame.

clips.name: workbook
clips.title: The Black Friday Profit Plan workbook
clips.shows: The real Black Friday Profit Plan PDF open in a browser PDF viewer at 150% — holding on the cover, then a smooth scroll into the Contents spread showing all 8 parts across 51 pages.

clips.name: dashboard
clips.title: Profitability Dashboard sheet
clips.shows: The real EcomIQ Profitability Dashboard Google Sheet — the cursor tracks down the measures column selecting live cells (the selection box and formula bar follow), then the sheet scrolls through the annual rows into the Direction of Travel summary.

clips.name: calculator
clips.title: True CAC Calculator
clips.shows: The real EcomIQ True CAC Calculator — the cursor selects the New customer ad spend field and types 42000, and the live result panel recalculates on every keystroke, landing on a true CAC of $77.48 against a reported $52.50.

clips.name: bf-workbook-hero
clips.title: Black Friday Profit Plan — hero (motion graphics)
clips.shows: A five-beat motion-graphics cut built from the REAL workbook pages: the 3D workbook slams in from depth, its pages whip out into a fan, 8 / 32 / 19 punch in, the contribution-margin worksheet flies in with its total lit in flame, and the 2026 Black Friday calendar lands with Black Friday lit. Deep navy ground with perspective grid, crosshair marks, vignette and grain; beats hand over on blur and scale alone, with no streaks or flashes.
clips.builtBy: scripts/build-hero.mjs (rendered from assets/pages/*.png — no screen recording)
